heard: Our solar system is drifting through a massive hollow cavity. Roughly 15 ancient supernovas blasted this hole 1,000 light years wide. It's filled with thin plasma heated to a million degrees. Deep sea crust on Earth still holds radioactive iron from those explosions. This giant bubble triggered the birth of every nearby star. Newborn star nurseries like Taurus sit on its shell, expanding outward. We didn't grow up here, we just wandered into the void. The sun is currently drifting through its very centre.
